scope: Independent DB/SQL theory with a new fictional library dataset; partial exam theory coverage only
originalSource: Read-only concepts-theory.json; origin IDs, original primary references and source hash retained in course.json

validation.sql: Every displayed result table executed against isolated PGlite; FK/CHECK/NULL/empty subquery/join checks and FD closure independently verified
validation.limits: PGlite is not real Postgres concurrency or production-performance validation

storage.scope: Browser-only, independent of existing CS/PMP/Jira/library keys
storage.notes: Expected-text comparison preserves same-note conflicts; checklist mutations read latest state; visiting preserves content timestamps
storage.backup: Separate version1 format. Different nonempty current note blocks import; unchanged note uses newer checks/review. Does not alter existing backup formats.

publication: Requires actual humanize-korean review and committed-text receipt before push
